description: Represent beds, paths, containers, rows, and protected structures as editable objects.
sourceInfluence: GrowVeg describes planning for rows, containers, raised beds, square-foot gardening, and varied garden shapes.

description: Use crop spacing data to warn about overcrowding and estimate how many plants fit in a bed.
sourceInfluence: GrowVeg emphasizes automatic spacing to avoid overcrowding.

description: Generate sow, transplant, protect, and harvest windows from frost dates, crop tolerance, and season length.
sourceInfluence: GrowVeg describes calendars tailored to local climate and weather-station data.

description: Track crop families by bed and year, then warn when a family repeats too often.
sourceInfluence: GrowVeg describes crop rotation notifications for soil-borne pest and disease prevention.

description: Show when a bed is occupied and identify windows for follow-up crops.
sourceInfluence: GrowVeg describes succession planting for seeing when and where more crops can be grown.

description: Attach notes, photos, watering, observations, issues, and harvests to plants and beds.
sourceInfluence: Atami and GrowVeg both emphasize garden journaling for learning what worked.

description: Recommend nearby flowers, herbs, and habitat based on pollinators, beneficial insects, and pest pressure.
sourceInfluence: GrowVeg describes evidence-based companion planting; veggie.farm should build its own cited model before making strong claims.

description: Track seed packets, age, source, quantity, germination notes, and planned use.
sourceInfluence: GrowVeg lists seed inventory as a planned feature.
